inlines.v: GAB'BLE, verb intransitive [Eng. to gibe.] 1. To prate; to talk fast, or to talk without meaning. Such a rout, and such a rabble, Run to hear Jack Pudding gabble 2. To utter inarticulate sounds with rapidity; as gabbling fowls. GAB'BLE, noun Loud or rapid talk with meaning. 1. Inarticulate sounds rapidly uttered, as of fowls.
